Yesterday, the Iranian Parliament (Majles) has approved the general framework of a 33-article “Countering Infiltration” proposal: Some clauses: - MOIS (Ministry of Intelligence and Security) would publish an annual whitelist of foreign governments, universities and institutions allowed for scholarships, grants, academic agreements and scientific events. Scientific cooperation off-list: over 6 months to 2 years in prison. - Give a foreign person or entity “any information, report or statistics” without MOIS permission: Over 2 to 5 years in prison + permanent exclusion from the job used to obtain or provide it. - An NGO or party receives foreign money, contracts, fees or training without approval from a committee including MOIS + IRGC Intelligence: Dissolution, prison, and directors banned from cultural/social work for 5–15 years. - Interview, dialogue or “any contact” with US, Israeli or state-listed “hostile media”: Over 6 months to 2 years. Interview other foreign media without first notifying MOIS through its system: Same. - Send a photo, video, voice note or “any data” to foreign media; or even someone doing media work abroad: Prison. Doing it during “unrest”: Potentially over 2 to 5 years. - Contact an embassy or foreign organization, inside or outside Iran, without notification + written permission: Fines + loss of social rights. - A foreign-directed film, book, music or theater project that “shows a black image of Iran” or questions religious rulings: Fines, permanent professional bans, and prosecutors may stop it mid-production. - Organize or send someone abroad to a course/workshop the state calls foreign-directed or “incompatible with Iranian culture”: Over 2 to 5 years. Knowingly join one online: Fine or prison. #Iran
